claims: The NBA SoFi Play-In Tournament concludes on Friday, April 17, 2026.
Charlotte Hornets vs. Orlando Magic is at 7:30 p.m. ET on Friday, April 17, 2026 on Prime Video.
Golden State Warriors vs. Phoenix Suns is at 10 p.m. ET on Friday, April 17, 2026 on Prime Video.
The winner of the Hornets-Magic game secures the No. 8 seed in the East.
The winner of the Warriors-Suns game secures the No. 8 seed in the West.
NBA first-round playoff games begin on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
Philadelphia 76ers vs. Boston Celtics is at 10 a.m. ET on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
Portland Trail Blazers vs. San Antonio Spurs is on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
